translationRepairs: The commentary says: After Prince Limi was deposed, from Princes Yinqi and Yin'e to the great ministers, many plotted to install Yinshi, but the Sacred Ancestor never permitted it.
The commentary says: After Prince Limi was deposed, from Princes Yintang and Yin'e to the great ministers, many plotted to install Yinshi, but the Sacred Ancestor never permitted it.
Chinese 允禟 is Yintang; Yinqi misreads a different imperial name (允祺). The proposed replacement corrects only that personal name and leaves the rest of the idiomatic intact.
